class.name: FoxEffectManager
class.brief_description: Handles the creation, lifecycle, and cleanup of [FoxEffectInstance] objects.

method.name: add_effect
method.description: Applies a [FoxEffect] to the [param target]. [br][br]Depending on the effect's [member FoxEffect.stack_mode], this will either return an updated existing instance or instantiate a brand new one.

method.name: remove_instance
method.description: Removes a specific instance object from tracking and executes its cleanup logic.

method.name: remove_effect_by_id
method.description: Removes active instances matching the specified [param target_id]. [br][br]If [param all_instances] is [code]false[/code], it will only remove the first one found.

method.name: remove_all_effects
method.description: Purges every active effect currently managed and runs their cleanup logic.

method.name: get_all_effect_ids
method.description: Returns an array of every unique [member FoxEffect.id] currently active on the target.

method.name: has_effect
method.description: A quick helper to check if a specific effect is currently active.

method.name: serialize
method.description: Returns an array of dictionaries representing the active state of all managed effects.

method.name: load_state
method.description: Rebuilds the active effects from saved data. Requires the [param target] and a [Callable] that takes a [StringName] ID and returns a [FoxEffect].

members.member: The internal list of currently active effect instances.

signal.name: effect_added
signal.description: Emitted immediately after a new [FoxEffectInstance] is instantiated and added.

signal.name: effect_removed
signal.description: Emitted immediately after a [FoxEffectInstance] is cleaned up and removed.
